hero.tag: Project Dossier · Group IB_13 · FPT University
hero.lead: Born from the graduation thesis of a team of FPT University students (Group IB_13), Bách Mã Viên is shaped as a pioneering cultural eco-complex and equestrian farm on the central coast, set along the Cổ Cò river that links Đà Nẵng and the heritage town of Hội An.
hero.manifesto: We are not just building a horse farm. We are reviving a proud way of life that honors freedom and the complete harmony between people and nature.
hero.researchText: Equine Welfare husbandry standards and international-grade outdoor tourism services.

collective.title: The Leadership Collective
collective.description: The strength of Bách Mã Viên comes from a passion for adventure, rigorous legal thinking and the financial and operational skill of a young generation of entrepreneurs.

strategy.title: Freedom and Wild West Grit
strategy.text: United in creating an authentic living and eco-tourism space in the Cổ Cò heritage area.

operations.title: Discipline and a Passion for Horses
operations.text: Applying international standards for guest safety and humane horse care.

leaders.title: Founders and Executive Team
leaders.description: Each person brings a key piece of expertise and a shared goal: building Vietnam's leading sustainable horse-riding tourism brand.

uyenPhuong.text: Oversees the project as a whole, plans long-term development strategy and coordinates every part of the Bách Mã Viên ranch's operations.

khoaLe.text: Leads horse research and development, sets Equine Welfare standards and builds interactive outdoor education programs.

hoangLam.text: Handles legal matters, builds safety standards for adventure tourism, protects the Bách Mã Viên brand and develops strategic partnerships.

boiNgoc.text: Plans the investment budget for stable infrastructure, builds the pricing model for riding packages and optimizes cash-flow resources.

anhThuOps.text: Coordinates guest-service operations, the on-site welcome process and safe experience management at the ranch.

anhThuBrand.text: Positions the Bách Mã Viên brand, builds the communications strategy and premium Western visual identity, and grows partnerships.

thesis.title: From a Student Project to a Brand
thesis.text: Bách Mã Viên began as a business plan for an eco-complex and equestrian farm in Đà Nẵng, prepared by Group IB_13 under the guidance of FPT University lecturers and presented in December 2026.
thesis.docTitle: Business Plan for an Eco-Complex and Equestrian Farm in Da Nang
thesis.mentors: Ms. Ngô Hà Trang and Ms. Phạm Thụy Trang

name.title: One Name, One Promise
name.description: Bách Mã means one hundred horses, a symbol of strength, freedom and timeless loyalty. Viên means a garden, a space preserved with every bit of care.

vision.title: An Ambition to Define New Heritage
vision.description: To make noble riding culture and the free Wild West experience a distinctive artistic element, adding a premium outdoor experience to the Đà Nẵng – Hội An tourism route.

welfare.title: Equine Welfare
welfare.text: A horse is a companion, not entertainment equipment. Nutrition, tropical-adapted stables and exercise time are strictly supervised by specialist veterinarians.

wildWest.title: Wild West, Real Feel
wildWest.text: Every sense is awakened: hooves drumming on sand, the scent of herb-tanned saddle leather, a crackling campfire and rustic western-style flavors.

heritage.title: Cổ Cò Riverside Heritage
heritage.text: Respecting the natural ecosystem of the lower Cổ Cò, growing native greenery and bringing local craft artisans into the ranch's value chain.

cta.title: Ready to Explore the Cổ Cò Prairie With Us?
cta.text: Schedule a ranch visit with our management team or discuss a strategic partnership.
